8.5.1.4 Single point interpolation
[SWS_Ifl_00030] Definition of API function Ifl_Interpolate_f32 ⌈
Service Name
Ifl_Interpolate_f32
Syntax
float32 Ifl_Interpolate_f32 (
float32 Value1,
float32 Value2,
float32 Coef
)
Service ID [hex]
0x06
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Value1
First value to be used in the interpolation.
Value2
Second value to be used in the interpolation.
Parameters (in)
Coef
Interpolation coefficient.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
float32
Iterpolated value
Description
Returns the result of the linear interpolation (Result), determined according to the following
equation.
Available via
Ifl.h
⌋
[SWS_Ifl_00031] ⌈Result = Value1 + (Coef * (Value2 - Value1))⌋
caption: 8.5.1.4 Single point interpolation
